# DualSpark Studio
> Custom Web Development, Bespoke Software, and 3D Interactive Web Applications

DualSpark Studio is a modern digital engineering and creative technology agency headquartered in Pune, India. We design and engineer high-performance web applications, interactive 3D digital experiences, and tailored business software with a strong focus on speed, user experience, and measurable business growth.

## Core Services & Solutions

### 1. Hospitality, Resort & Villa Website Development
- Custom websites designed specifically for luxury resorts, boutique villas, vacation rentals, and hotels.
- Direct booking engine integrations to maximize commission-free direct reservations.
- Interactive room and amenity galleries, real-time availability calendars, and multi-currency secure payment processing.
- Mobile-first, speed-optimized digital presence ensuring high conversion rates for international travelers.

### 2. 3D Interactive Web Experiences
- Immersive WebGL and Three.js development running natively in all modern web browsers.
- 3D product configurators, virtual showrooms, spatial portfolio showcases, and interactive 3D visualizations.
- Smooth GLSL shaders, camera animations, and high frame-rate rendering optimized for mobile and desktop devices.

### 3. Custom Web & Cloud Software
- Bespoke SaaS platforms, customer portals, inventory systems, and admin dashboards.
- Full-stack engineering using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL.
- RESTful & WebSocket API design, secure authentication (OAuth/JWT), and database architecture.

### 4. Technical SEO & Performance Optimization
- Core Web Vitals engineering (LCP, INP, CLS optimization).
- Comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD structured data and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).
- Mobile speed optimization, code-splitting, and asset delivery pipeline configuration.

## Technologies Used
- Frontend: React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- 3D & Creative Tech: Three.js, WebGL, React Three Fiber, GLSL Shaders, Framer Motion, GSAP
- Backend & Data: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM
- Deployment: Netlify, Serverless PostgreSQL
